# REST API Auth Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > REST API

## Overview

Implements REST API authentication and authorization with OAuth2, JWT, and API keys for secure API access control

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [rest-api-auth-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
rest-api-auth-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@rest-api-auth-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Implement OAuth2 authorization flows
- Configure JWT validation and claims
- Manage API key lifecycle and rotation
- Implement scope-based authorization

## Technology Standards Applied

- **OAuth2**: OAuth2 authorization framework
- **JWT**: JSON Web Token specification
- **API Security**: OWASP API Security Top 10
